One circuit, built wire by wire and broken fast

Toy transformer, addition mod 113, then multiplication. Each node is a weight matrix: its spectrum (peaks above the shuffle edge = organised directions, the low base = what the entry distribution explains) and a sketch of the matrix. Wires run through the shared residual stream; thickness = wire count against a random rotation. Numbers are seed means from STATE 5, 15 and the joint runs.
